author: Aaron
text:
Hi AndyFX,

I hope you do not mind me having a pop at answering your questions before another senior does?

I spent quite a while looking at your first chart trying to work out where the best place the FL would be, I could not see it, and as I have read before, if I cannot be seen easily it may not be there, so I went to the 30 minute chart and this is what I found below, for me this looks much clearer.

2nd chart looks like a nice FL.

Not too sure about the 3rd...

4th chart was a nice FL for me, but as we can see price was unable to break the lower FL just below (RBR), but was probably a few opportunities on the LTFs I think.

Last chart, the 15 minute defo looks like a FL to me, nice pole up, nice SR, important this is too, from what I have seen from my charts is there can be FLs within FLs if this makes sense, just as you may be possibly seeing here, the FL on the 15 minute is fully formed and already had an FTB, but what we do not know is whether the FL on the 4hr will turn out to be a FL at all, as we have not seen the upper or lower limits broken yet.

Andy, I am sorry if I have misread your questions, and answered incorrectly, I hope it helps

Hi Andy,

I am still learning the differences of the FL too, and yes it is confusing in the beginning, but I think I read this thread well over 5 times, taking notes, regarding decent SRs, poles up/down, long accumulation time, a quote from Harry: 'Some are easy to see and tidy, others are ugly, stay away and play the pretty ones',

I read the article god knows how many times too, and if you look closely all the FL areas are never in exactly the same place... so don't threat too much about that I think. Just post up as many charts as possible and it will become clear.
